author: Antonio Clim
scope: Additive native CLI to replay-checked JSON report and standalone offline HTML reader with separate mutable feedback. This is a declared alternative browser pathway, not in-browser measurement, a Pyodide migration or a drop-in S01 v3 complete report.

bridge.capsule: Retain the unchanged S04 capsule and its digest. Use source replay with independently supplied language, task and explicit profile ID/digest before native rendering or feedback admission.
bridge.coordinates: Preserve evidence IDs and one-based inclusive normalised physical-line spans. Existing C0-C0 values are sentinels, not character selections. Browser navigation resolves owned line-span evidence only; never fabricate exact token highlights.
bridge.states: Preserve observation applicability, dimension state, descriptive-only results, no-rule-trigger, policy-sensitive abstention and optional review opportunities as distinct labelled outcomes. All seven dimensions and five withheld mappings remain visible.
bridge.identity: Separate S04 specification/build/profile identity from S05 presentation component hashes. A digest is not authentication. The generated HTML is a presentation snapshot; it does not replay arbitrary imported capsules.

privacy.path_default: Use a neutral source label before measurement; real path disclosure requires an explicit CLI option.
privacy.source_default: Omit literal source from HTML and JSON unless explicitly requested. Source-derived callable identifiers and content hashes in the complete capsule remain potentially sensitive; minimisation is not anonymisation.
privacy.browser: All runtime CSS and JavaScript are embedded. No CDN, Pyodide, fetch, telemetry, storage API or service worker is required. Apply hash-bound CSP and test actual network/storage behaviour in a fresh Chromium context.
privacy.responses: Keep responses outside immutable evidence. Explicit export writes a separate user-requested file. Clear removes active response state and revokes generated object URLs, but does not promise secure erasure of downloaded files, original reports, browser/OS caches, backups or snapshots.
privacy.source_execution: Never execute supplied source. Native parser/resource limits remain bounded, not universal containment.

acceptance.criterion: Exact S04 ancestry and unchanged inherited bytes; lock precedes evaluation and final candidate CI belongs to its exact SHA.
Closed report/feedback schemas and explicit S01/S04 compatibility decisions; all capsule fields remain available in the JSON bundle.
Valid capsule replay succeeds; changed values, evidence, non-inferences, source, profile, context and build are rejected even with recomputed transported digests.
All three unchanged profiles and the seven dimensions are represented. Five withheld dimensions cannot be labelled favourable.
Below, at and above structural threshold boundaries preserve exact S04 decisions; nominal-trigger disagreement retains abstention.
Empty source, no callable, syntax error, non-Python inputs and unsupported/invalid bytes receive distinct outcomes or recoverable refusals; no zeros replace missingness.
Every item resolves to its record and owned evidence. Unicode/newline/BOM source navigation uses declared line spans; unavailable span is not fabricated.
Only actual review opportunities admit feedback. Responses bind exact report and opportunity identities, reject foreign/stale/duplicate references and cannot mutate evidence.
Default path/source minimisation and explicit source/path inclusion are tested. Hashes and source-derived identifiers remain disclosed privacy residuals.
Rendered source and metadata cannot introduce executable HTML or external resource URLs. Test hostile markup and controls; preserve originals only in explicit data output.
Standalone HTML loads and operates without external requests or app storage in a fresh Chromium context; CSP rejects unauthorised execution and network attempts.
Keyboard evidence navigation, visible focus, semantic headings/labels, status/error announcements and 320-CSS-pixel reflow are exercised on the actual reader.
Feedback validation error, retry, export, clear and reload journeys work; current-state deletion limits are visibly explained.
Independent negative controls detect missing withheld-state disclosure, misleading favourable labels, unresolved evidence and unsafe injected markup.
CLI refuses missing/invalid/symlink inputs and existing outputs without clobbering; outputs are outside the source tree and terminal errors do not expose source contents or path values.
Report replay rejects presentation/component drift; preserve actual runtime/build identity without pretending cross-runtime full-report equality.
Retain every observed failing test and corrective deviation, exact command outcomes and raw browser evidence; no invented manual screen-reader or participant assessment.
Individually adjudicate inherited browser/SRI/Chromium/privacy findings against exercised paths; keep legacy acquisition/distribution findings and A01-F003 open unless directly proven.
Update all 20 final gates and claim-evidence registers without empirical, release or manuscript closure by implication.
Deliver verified source/archive/bundle, tests and CI evidence, privacy/accessibility scope and exact next-phase instruction; stop before M01.

finite_design.sampling: Dependent synthetic conformance fixtures, not population or participant observations.
finite_design.oracle: Compare rendered states, references and decisions against unchanged S04 results and hand-specified boundary expectations; deliberate mutants must fail independent checks.
finite_design.tolerance: Identifiers, decisions, states, labels and canonical bytes exact; layout allows at most one CSS pixel of rounding for overflow checks.

ci.browser: Chromium on Ubuntu with recorded actual browser/driver versions, after local Chromium tests. Other browsers, manual assistive-technology testing and hosted Pyodide behaviour are not inferred.
ci.regression: Run inherited S01/S02 and S03/S04 unit contracts; do not rerun the entire historical S03/S04 experiments merely for reassurance.
